name_zh: 乌鲁格别克：萨马尔罕天文台的『科学革命法』与伊斯兰文艺复兴治理范式
name_en: Ulugh Beg: The Samarkand Observatory — 'Scientific Revolution Method' and Islamic Renaissance Governance Paradigm
description_zh: 乌鲁格别克（Mirza Muhammad Taragai ulugh Beg，1394-1449）是帖木儿帝国第三代统治者、萨马尔罕总督（1409-1449）和伟大的天文学家-君主。他是帖木儿之孙，苏丹·穆罕默德·苏丹加拉（Sultan Muhammad Sultan Qara）之子。乌鲁格别克的核心思维贡献在于将'伊斯兰文艺复兴（Islamic Renaissance）'从文化装饰升维为可操作的科学革命工程——通过'天文台建设→恒星表编制→数学革新→教育体系化'四阶段路径，在15世纪中亚建立了当时世界最精密的天文观测体系。他在萨马尔罕建造的世界最大象限仪（半径40米），亲自编制了《乌鲁格别克恒星表》（Zij-i Sultani，1437年），包含1018颗恒星的精确位置数据（精度优于托勒密《天文学大成》），并修正了岁差值和黄赤交角。乌鲁格别克是Protreptic中模式34（战略预判法）在'科学革命工程化'场景的唯一中亚样本，也是模式12（系统思维）在'跨文明科学知识整合'场景的独特代表。他的《乌鲁格别克恒星表》直接影响了哥白尼和开普勒，是欧洲文艺复兴天文学的重要知识来源。他对理解科学革命如何在伊斯兰文明内部发生、以及跨文化知识传承机制具有不可替代的研究价值。
description_en: Mirza Muhammad Taragai ulugh Beg (1394-1449) was the third ruler of the Timurid Empire, governor of Samarkand (1409-1449), and a great astronomer-ruler. Grandson of Timur, son of Sultan Muhammad. Ulugh Beg's core contribution was engineering 'Islamic Renaissance' from cultural ornamentation into actionable scientific revolution — across four phases: observatory construction, stellar catalog compilation, mathematical innovation, and educational systematization. He built the world's largest mural quadrant (40m radius) in Samarkand, personally compiling the 'Zij-i Sultani' (1437) containing precise positions of 1,018 stars (superior to Ptolemy's Almagest accuracy), correcting precession and obliquity values. Ulugh Beg is the key Central Asian sample of mode 34 (Strategic Prediction) in 'scientific revolution engineering' and the unique representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'cross-cultural scientific knowledge integration.' His Zij-i Sultani directly influenced Copernicus and Kepler, serving as crucial knowledge source for European Renaissance astronomy. His work provides irreplaceable insights into how scientific revolutions occur within Islamic civilization and cross-cultural knowledge transmission mechanisms.
reason_zh: 乌鲁格别克填补了Protreptic在'伊斯兰文明科学革命工程化'领域的中亚空白。他以君主身份亲自从事天文学研究的独特经历，展示了科学革命如何在非欧洲文明中发生；也是模式34在'跨世纪科学知识传承与超越'场景的唯一中亚样本。他的《乌鲁格别克恒星表》对哥白尼革命的间接贡献，以及他在中亚建立的科学教育中心，对理解伊斯兰文明的知识传承具有不可替代的研究价值。
reason_en: Ulugh Beg fills Protreptic's Central Asian gap in 'Islamic civilization scientific revolution engineering.' His unique experience as a ruler personally conducting astronomy demonstrates how scientific revolutions occur in non-European civilizations; also the sole Central Asian sample of mode 34 in 'cross-century scientific knowledge transmission and transcendence.' His Zij-i Sultani's indirect contribution to the Copernican Revolution, and his scientific educational center in Central Asia, provide irreplaceable insights into Islamic civilization knowledge transmission.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式34战略预判法）：天文台建设决策——判断'精确天文学数据是帝国统治合法性和宗教历法准确性的基础'，在萨马尔罕建立当时世界最大的天文台，配备半径40米的巨型扇形仪（Fakhri Sextant）和多种精密观测仪器，这是15世纪全球最先进天文设施
第2步（模式12系统思维）：跨文明知识整合工程——汇集来自波斯、阿拉伯、印度和中国（伊斯兰世界已吸收的）天文学知识，建立统一观测标准；邀请巴格达、撒马尔罕、布哈拉等地天文学家合作，在30年（1420-1449）持续观测中积累数据
第3步（模式20价值链重构）：《乌鲁格别克恒星表》编制——亲自参与每一颗恒星的观测数据校核，编制包含1018颗恒星精确位置的《Zij-i Sultani》（苏丹历表），修正托勒密体系中的岁差值（从50.8秒调整为49.76秒，接近现代值49.83秒）和黄赤交角
第4步（模式7战略预判法）： madrasah 教育体系——在萨马尔罕建立Madrasah-i-Ulug Beg（乌鲁格伯 Madrasah），将天文学、数学、法学整合为系统教育体系，培养新一代伊斯兰学者；其学生包括著名数学家 al-Kashi 的继承者
第5步（范式固化）：科学革命法——将'天文台→知识整合→恒星表→教育体系'四环沉淀为伊斯兰文明内部科学革命的可操作工程模板
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 34 Strategic Prediction): Observatory construction decision — judged that 'precise astronomical data is foundation of imperial legitimacy and religious calendar accuracy'; built world's largest observatory in Samarkand with 40m mural quadrant (Fakhri Sextant) and precision instruments — the most advanced astronomical facility of 15th century

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Cross-cultural knowledge integration — synthesized Persian, Arabic, Indian and Chinese (absorbed by Islamic world) astronomical knowledge; unified observation standards; invited astronomers from Baghdad, Samarkand, Bukhara for 30 years (1420-1449) of continuous data collection

Step 3 (Mode 20 Value Chain Reconstruction): Zij-i Sultani compilation — personally verified every star's observational data, compiling 'Zij-i Sultani' (Sultan's Tables) with precise positions of 1,018 stars; corrected Ptolemy's precession value (from 50.8 to 49.76 seconds, near modern 49.83) and obliquity

Step 4 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Madrasah educational system — established Madrasah-i-Ulug Beg in Samarkand, integrating astronomy, mathematics and jurisprudence into systematic education;培养新一代伊斯兰学者 including al-Kashi's successors

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Scientific revolution method — condensing 'observatory → knowledge integration → stellar tables → educational system' into an operable template for scientific revolution within Islamic civilization
expected_zh: 掌握乌鲁格别克从帖木儿帝国君主到科学家的双重身份路径
理解《乌鲁格别克恒星表》的科学价值及其对哥白尼革命的间接影响
评估伊斯兰文明内部科学革命机制对理解知识传承的启示
expected_en: Master Ulugh Beg's dual identity as Timurid ruler and scientist
Understand the scientific value of 'Zij-i Sultani' and its indirect influence on the Copernican Revolution
Evaluate insights from Islamic civilization internal scientific revolution mechanisms for knowledge transmission
case_zh: 1394年3月22日生于撒马尔罕，帖木儿之孙。7岁随祖父远征印度，1409年父亲去世后继承萨马尔罕总督之位。在位期间（1409-1449）将萨马尔罕打造为伊斯兰世界科学文化中心。1420年开始建造天文台，动用大量资源建设半径40米的巨型扇形仪。亲自参与长达30年的天文观测，编制《Zij-i Sultani》（1437年完成），包含1018颗恒星精确位置，精度远超托勒密《天文学大成》。修正岁差值为49.76秒（现代值49.83），黄赤交角为23°30'。1447年继承祖父帖木儿成为帝国统治者，但因宗教保守派（乌里玛）压力被迫放弃部分异端科学活动。1449年被其子阿布拉菲鲁德（Abd al-Latif）发动政变推翻并处死。他的天文台和《恒星表》手稿在随后的政治动荡中部分散失，但副本流传至印度（Jaisalmer天文台）和欧洲。哥白尼在《天体运行论》中多次引用乌鲁格别克的数据，第谷·布拉赫也参考了他的观测结果。
case_en: Born March 22, 1394 in Samarkand, grandson of Timur. At age 7 accompanied grandfather on Indian expedition; inherited Samarkand governorship after father's death in 1409. Transformed Samarkand into Islamic world scientific center during his rule (1409-1449). Began observatory construction in 1420, deploying massive resources for 40m mural quadrant. Personally participated in 30 years of astronomical observation, compiling 'Zij-i Sultani' (completed 1437) with precise positions of 1,018 stars, superior to Ptolemy's Almagest accuracy. Corrected precession to 49.76 seconds (modern: 49.83), obliquity to 23°30'. Inherited Timurid Empire in 1447 but was forced to abandon some heterodox scientific activities under pressure from conservative ulema. Overthrown and executed in 1449 by his son Abd al-Latif's coup. His observatory and stellar tables were partially lost in subsequent political turmoil, but copies survived to India (Jaisalmer observatory) and Europe. Copernicus cited Ulugh Beg's data multiple times in 'De Revolutionibus'; Tycho Brahe also referenced his observations.
